description: Results of the Fed's most recent repo operations (the Standing Repo Facility): amounts banks submitted and the Fed accepted, split by collateral (Treasury, agency, mortgage-backed) with the offering rate. Straight from the New York Fed; take-up is the headline sign of month- and quarter-end funding stress. Results only, not the forward schedule; reverse repo has its own tool. (cost: 1 credit)

last_n.description: integer, optional, number of most recent operations, 1-50, default 5

name: fed_repo_operations_results
